text:
Riley (CS): Heads-up — I drafted a customer-facing 'Stability Sentinel' playbook for onboarding customers that need tight SLAs during ramp. Focus: simple checks, prefill/caching, batching defaults, and an ops escalation flow. Sharing for quick feedback. :eyes:
Aisha (CS): love the name. can you add a tiny checklist for renewal-risk signals? low usage + frequent timeouts should surface to AMs. :warning:
Riley (CS): yes — plan is to include a 3-tier signal: engagement_score < 0.6, >5% error rate over 1h, and repeated >250ms tail latency. we'll add alert text for AMs.
Priya (SRE): quick note on implementation — prefer a short-lived prefix cache (ttl=10m) for onboarding burst traffic rather than long global cache. avoids staleness and keeps cold-start smooth.
Tom (AE): can we include a blurb for customers about how to measure health on their side? e.g., synthetic probes + a recommended sample prompt set for accuracy checks. makes conversations with renewal teams easier.
Riley (CS): yep. will add a sample probe and a tiny prompt set. also adding a one-click feedback link so CS can gather qualitative notes during the first 14 days.
Jenny (PM): include a tiny config snippet customers can paste into their infra to get recommended defaults. keep it language-agnostic YAML.
Riley (CS): putting a compact YAML in the runbook now. feel free to nit.
Riley (CS): ```yaml
# Stability Sentinel defaults (onboarding)
cache:
  prefix: "onboard-{{tenant_id}}"
  ttl_seconds: 600  # 10m
batching:
  enabled: true
  max_batch_tokens: 2048
  request_timeout_ms: 4000
streaming:
  enabled: false  # default for small customers to simplify retries
observability:
  emit_metrics: ["latency_p95_ms","errors_pct","engagement_score"]
  feedback_form: "https://forms.example.com/onboard-feedback"
```
Aisha (CS): nice. maybe call out when streaming should be turned on (chat UX, low token size, high concurrency).
Priya (SRE): +1. also add a small runbook step for graceful priming if a tenant is bursty: sequential prefill with jittered backoff, and a short ramp window (10-30m). example command: `prefill --tenant $TENANT --Concurrency 4 --jitter 0.2`
Tom (AE): important: link to the renewal-risk playbook so AMs can see what signals mean and recommended outreach templates.
Riley (CS): added cross-link to renewal playbook and a 4-line outreach template.
Jenny (PM): small UX ask — add a one-click 'apply defaults' for Dedicated customers via Console (we'll coordinate with eng).
Priya (SRE): Ops note: make sure the sentinel health checks are low-cardinality metrics (tenant tag only) to avoid monitoring explosion. docs should call this out.
Riley (CS): good call. added a short section.
Aisha (CS): I'll run this with two pilot customers next week and capture feedback. I'll post the initial notes in this thread. :rocket:
OpsBot: pinned message to channel (Stability Sentinel playbook draft)
Tom (AE): thanks all — looks actionable. small ask: include an FAQ entry about token accounting and how caching affects billing so AMs can explain to customers.
Riley (CS): will add billing FAQ. final ask: anyone want editing rights to the doc? I'll make it a shared doc and drop the link here.
Priya (SRE): I can take a pass on the implementation steps tomorrow.
Aisha (CS): I'll take care of pilot notes.
Tom (AE): I'll prep the renewal outreach template examples after pilot.
Riley (CS): link: https://docs.internal/redwood/stability-sentinel-onboard (edit: team) — thanks everyone, should be ready for pilot prep.
